text:
All 25 tests now pass. There were seven separate logic bugs, and each fix was a one-line change in the code under `taskflow/`. I didn't touch the tests.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `queue.py` (`_Entry.sort_key`) | The sort key was `(seq, -priority)`, so tasks came out in the order they were added and priority was ignored. | Changed it to `(-priority, seq)`, as the docstring says. |
| `retry.py` (`should_retry`) | It checked `attempts_made < max_attempts - 1`, so every task got one attempt fewer than its budget. | Changed it to `attempts_made < max_attempts`. |
| `config.py` (`deep_merge`) | The recursive call had its arguments swapped, so for nested blocks like `retry` the defaults overwrote what the task set. A task's own `max_attempts: 3` was lost and replaced by the default of 1. | Changed it to `deep_merge(result[key], value)`. |
| `resources.py` (`ResourcePool.release`) | It always gave back 1 unit instead of the task's actual cost. Pools stayed partly full, so later tasks that needed resources never started. | Changed it to `self.used -= cost`. |
| `statemachine.py` (`batch_order_ok`) | The comparison was backwards. Once the queue handed out tasks in the correct order, this check rejected them and failed tasks outright. This bug only showed up after the queue fix. | Changed it to `current_priority <= prev_priority`. |
| `scheduler.py` (`_cascade_skip`) | Only the failed task's direct children were skipped. Tasks further downstream were stuck in `PENDING`. | Changed it to use `dag.transitive_dependents`. |
| `events.py` (`_prefix_matches`) | The prefix check was reversed, so the history's `job.term` subscription never received `job.term.failed` and the other final-outcome events. | Changed it to `topic.startswith(prefix + ".")`. |

As you warned, several failures came from a different module than the test's name suggests. The retry tests in `test_pipelines` were failing because of the merge bug in `config.py`, not only `retry.py`. The priority pipeline tests needed both the queue fix and the reversed check in the state machine. The history tests depended on the event-bus prefix fix.
